Here’s how it unfolds.

  1. 01
    ARRIVE

    Say hello.

    Check in, meet the other students, and get a feel for the space.

    Check-in & opening briefing
  2. 02
    CONNECT

    Find your team.

    Get 2–5 people together. Compare ideas and choose one to work on.

    Team formation & project ideas
  3. 03
    MAKE

    Get into it.

    Build, test, get stuck, try again. Give your idea its first working version.

  4. 04
    REFINE

    Make it click.

    Test the parts that matter. Put together a short demo of what you’ve made.

    Final checks & submission
  5. 05

    Show your work.

    Walk everyone through your project, answer questions, and see what others built.

    Demos & closing

A few useful things

Before you join.

Who can take part?+

Refract is for current PRISMS students. You can join with friends or find a team at the event. Teams have 2–5 people.

Do I need to have a team already?+

No. Come with an idea, a team, or neither. There will be time to meet other participants and choose a project together.

Does it have to be a coding project?+

No. Software, hardware, robotics, scientific computing and data projects all belong here. You can combine subjects, too.

When and where is it?+

On the PRISMS campus. The dates, room, and detailed timings will be announced once confirmed.

How does registration work?+

Sign in with Google, GitHub, or email, then enter your name and confirm you attend PRISMS. Your registration starts as pending; signing up does not automatically confirm a place.

Who can I contact?+

Email Aaron or John with questions about the event, registration, or supporting Refract.
